name: dev.forestrie/register
title: Sign and register statements on a Forestrie log
description: Sign and register statements on a Forestrie log, verify receipts, buy grants via x402 within caps

environmentVariables.name: FORESTRIE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Canopy SCRAPI base URL used when a call omits baseUrl; also the only origin a payer will pay. No default.

environmentVariables.name: FORESTRIE_ROOT_LOG_ID
environmentVariables.description: The forest's root log id (R in /register/{R}/entries) when a call omits rootLogId.

environmentVariables.name: FORESTRIE_GRANT
environmentVariables.description: Your Forestrie-Grant for the data log, as base64 or a file path, when a call omits grant.

environmentVariables.name: FORESTRIE_AUTHORITY_GRANT
environmentVariables.description: Your authority log's creation grant, for issue_grant, register_grant and delegate_sealing as authority.

environmentVariables.name: FORESTRIE_KNOWN_SEALER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The registrar's sealer voucher key, base64 x||y, for delegate_sealing.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for key files, grants, registrations and the spend ledger; default ~/.config/forestrie/mcp-register.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: The log key file (ES256 JWK, mode 600); created on first use if missing.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_AUTHORITY_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: The authority key file (ES256 JWK, mode 600) that signs child grants; created on first use if missing.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_PAYER_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional payer: a file holding your EVM key (0x + 64 hex, mode 600). Unset means relay mode: nothing is spent, your own x402 wallet pays.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_PAY_MAX_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Most one payment may be, in the asset's atomic units. Required with a payer.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_PAY_MAX_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Most all payments in one UTC day may total, in atomic units. Required with a payer.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_PAY_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: The one network it pays on; default eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_PAY_ASSET
environmentVariables.description: The one asset it pays in; default USDC on Base Sepolia. Required off the default network.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Optional: the only payee address it will pay.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REGISTER_PAY_ALLOW_MAINNET
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow paying on a network that is not a testnet; off by default.
